unit: Unit 12: Everyday Life with Your Computer
title: What a QR code really is
drDigitalIntro:
A QR code is a web address written as a pattern of squares instead of letters.
• Your phone's camera reads the pattern and shows you the address it contains.
• Nothing happens automatically — you still have to tap the address to go there.
• That pause is the important bit. Read the address before you tap it, exactly as you would a link in an email.
• The QR code on this practice menu contains one address. Type it in yourself.

playgroundTask.instructions: The QR code on the café menu contains this address. Type it in and press Enter.
playgroundTask.prompt: The code on the table reads: menu.cafe.example

drDigitalSuccess: A QR code is a link in disguise, and a link is something you read before you follow.
drDigitalHint: Type menu.cafe.example exactly as the code gives it.
